info.name: Cribl As Code API Credentials Destinations API

description.content:
The Cribl As Code API enables developers to manage Cribl configurations programmatically using infrastructure-as-code principles. The management plane API provides endpoints for administrative tasks in Cribl Cloud including managing organizations, workspaces, and API credentials. Developers can use this API alongside SDKs for Python, Go, and TypeScript, or through Terraform providers, to onboard sources, build and maintain pipelines, and standardize workflows at scale. The management plane supports creating and configuring Cribl Cloud workspaces, managing API credentials, and controlling access to organizational resources.
